layout.shell_description: No persistent navigation. Single-page app with a centered content area (max-width 960px, padded 24px). Page header contains app title on the left and an 'Add Task' button on the right. Below the header: filter controls (status dropdown) and sort toggle (by due date). The task list fills the remaining viewport height. No sidebar, no tabs, no bottom bar.

adaptation.notes: No responsive breakpoints or mobile adaptations in v1. The app is designed exclusively for desktop browser use.

screen_type_patterns.description: The main task list screen — the only full-page screen in the app
screen_type_patterns.header_area: App title ('MySimpleTodo') on the left; 'Add Task' button (btn-primary) on the right; below: status filter dropdown and due-date sort toggle
screen_type_patterns.body_area: Scrollable list of task-list-item cards. Each card shows title, due-date badge, status badge, and edit/delete action buttons. Filter and sort are applied client-side.

states.display: DaisyUI skeleton rows replacing task cards during initial data fetch
Centered empty-state with message 'No tasks yet.' and 'Add Task' button
DaisyUI alert-error banner at top of list with retry button
Full task list rendered with filter and sort applied

screen_type_patterns.description: Create or edit a task — displayed as a modal overlay on top of the list screen
screen_type_patterns.header_area: Modal title ('New Task' or 'Edit Task') on the left; close (X) icon button on the right
screen_type_patterns.body_area: Three fields stacked vertically: Title (text input, required), Due Date (date input, optional), Status (select — Todo / In Progress / Done)

states.display: Fields empty for create, or pre-filled with existing task values for edit
Save button shows loading spinner, all fields and buttons disabled
Inline DaisyUI alert-error below each invalid field; Save button re-enabled
Modal closes automatically; task list refreshes; success toast displayed

component_patterns.notes: DaisyUI card row. Left: task title (font-medium, truncated to 1 line). Center: due-date badge (badge-warning if overdue, badge-ghost otherwise). Right of center: status badge (badge-ghost for Todo, badge-info for In Progress, badge-success for Done). Far right: edit icon button (pencil, btn-ghost btn-sm) and delete icon button (trash, btn-ghost btn-sm btn-error). Clicking the edit button opens the Form modal pre-filled with the task data.

DaisyUI modal (dialog element). Title input is full-width with label above. Date input is full-width with label above. Status select is full-width with label above. Validation errors appear as text-error text below the relevant field. Footer uses flex justify-end gap-2.
DaisyUI badge component. Todo → badge-ghost (neutral). In Progress → badge-info (blue). Done → badge-success (green). Always includes text label — color is never the sole indicator.
DaisyUI skeleton component. Renders 5 skeleton rows at task-list-item height during initial fetch. Replaces the task list in loading state.
DaisyUI toast positioned bottom-right. Uses alert-success for save/delete success and alert-error for failures. Auto-dismisses after 3 seconds. One toast shown at a time.

input_navigation.dismiss: Escape key or click outside modal

structure_semantics.heading_hierarchy: Single h1 for app title; section headings as h2 where applicable
structure_semantics.labels: Form inputs have associated label elements
structure_semantics.error_association: Error text placed immediately below the relevant input

text_content.icon_only_elements: Action icon buttons (edit, delete, close) include title or aria-label attributes
text_content.images_and_media: No images or media in v1

design_notes: DaisyUI light theme used as-is — all color tokens map directly to DaisyUI CSS variables (--b1, --b2, --p, --er, --su, --wa). No custom theme override required. Status badges always include a text label alongside color to avoid color-only distinction. No dark mode in v1. Desktop-only — no responsive breakpoints.
